This leads to decreased availability of nucleotides essential for both mitochondrial ATP synthesis and mitochondrial DNA maintenance. Impaired ATP synthesis in hematopoietic stem cells results in reticular dysgenesis, while impaired mtDNA maintenance leads to mtDNA depletion, causing mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome 21 and associated phenotypes.
